reason: Both sell restaurant meals to consumers. Wendy's is a global, mostly franchised quick-service burger brand with drive-thru and delivery. Flanigan's runs a handful of casual full-service sports-bar restaurants and package liquor stores in South Florida. The restaurant overlap is real, but the format (quick-service vs. full-service bar), the model (franchisor vs. mostly owner-operator with liquor retail) and the geography and scale differ. That makes it adjacent, not direct.
